clips.title: 炼油厂98%利用率：库存却见底，农民先扛价

subtitles.en: Paul Sankiew, Sankiew Research, is joining us around the table. He writes the following, an industry running at 98% capacity is risky.
subtitles.zh: Sankey研究公司的Paul Sankey加入我们圆桌讨论。他写道，一个产能利用率达98%的行业是有风险的。

subtitles.en: Paul Giants is now for more. Paul Gamonik, how close are we for a big problem?
subtitles.zh: Paul Giants现在更多。Paul Gamonik，我们离大问题有多近？

subtitles.en: One refinery going down. So if we have a major refining accident here, which, thankfully, we haven't had hurricanes as yet this season, and we're getting quite deep into it, that was one concern.
subtitles.zh: 一家炼油厂停产。所以如果这里发生重大炼油事故，幸运的是，本季至今没有飓风，而且我们已经进入较深阶段，那曾是一个担忧。

subtitles.en: The biggest down time we ever had in U.S. refining was winter storm Uri, which was in 21 in February, 21.
subtitles.zh: 美国炼油业历史上最长的停工是冬季风暴Uri，发生在21年2月。

subtitles.en: So that is still out there, depending on how you view El Nino. But in fact, with inventories, I think, this little inventories are at operational minimums now.
subtitles.zh: 所以这仍然存在，取决于你如何看待厄尔尼诺。但事实上，就库存而言，我认为这些库存现在处于运营最低水平。

subtitles.en: We've never seen them go lower than this. That's the observation. So this is the lowest they've ever gotten, as we would say.
subtitles.zh: 我们从未见过它们比这更低。这就是观察结果。所以这是它们有史以来最低的，正如我们所说。

subtitles.en: And as a result, any major outage in refining, particularly in the U.S. would be extremely damaging and give you more upside right at harvest time.
subtitles.zh: 因此，任何重大炼油中断，尤其是在美国，都将极具破坏性，并在收获季节给你带来更多上行空间。

subtitles.en: So one of our concerns here is that the farmers are pricing elastic. They have to harvest, and so they're going to have to pay this price.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们这里的一个担忧是，农民的价格弹性。他们必须收获，所以他们不得不支付这个价格。

subtitles.en: And that's tough. And as you can see, the president has tuned in that the problem is diesel, not how much oil Saudi is getting out.
subtitles.zh: 这很艰难。正如你所看到的，总统已经指出问题在于柴油，而不是沙特开采多少石油。

subtitles.en: Although, of course, that will bring down the price of crude. So you mentioned the farmers.
subtitles.zh: 当然，尽管这会降低原油价格。所以你提到了农民。
en_highlights: bring down the price of crude

subtitles.en: They're the ones that are pushing the president to actually, or the Congress, to announce an embargo on diesel.
subtitles.zh: 他们正推动总统或国会宣布柴油出口禁令。

subtitles.en: Walk us through what that would mean for refineries if we would see an export ban.
subtitles.zh: 请讲讲如果实施出口禁令，对炼油厂意味着什么。

subtitles.en: Well, there's the unintended consequences, right?
subtitles.zh: 嗯，会有意想不到的后果，对吧？

clip_research.source_claim: An industry running at 98% capacity is risky; refined product inventories are at operational minimums never seen lower, so any major U.S. refining outage would be extremely damaging and give more upside right at harvest time, when farmers must pay the price.
clip_research.public_baseline: U.S. refinery utilization has been reported near 95–98% in recent years, and diesel inventories have been tight; Winter Storm Uri in February 2021 was a major refining disruption.
clip_research.surprise_gap: Sankey frames the current setup as uniquely fragile because inventories are at record operational minimums, a stronger claim than the general 'near capacity' baseline.

evidence.fact: Sankey says an industry running at 98% capacity is risky and inventories are at operational minimums never seen lower.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
